post.caption:
€184 on yourself this week. €0 for Allah. 🛒

Saturday, 9:40 a.m., the checkout queue. In front of you, an old man counts his coins, puts the milk back, then the bread. Eighty cents short. You tap your card again: “His milk and bread too.” Sunday, the bakery: two loaves, you pay for four.

“So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.” (99:7)

This morning: €5 for Allah. Before anything for yourself.

captions: Coffee pods. Crisps. A charger you didn’t need.
€47.90. You don’t even read the receipt.
In front of you, an old man counts his coins.
He puts the milk back. Then the bread.
Eighty cents short. He says sorry to the cashier.
You tap your card again. “His milk and bread too.”
Sunday, 7:05 a.m. The bakery on your street.
Two loaves. You pay for four.
“The other two are for whoever can’t pay.”
€5.50. The best money you spent all week.
